label: UI
tooltip: Language, what shows in the main window, reward icons, and tracker graphs.

language.label: Language
language.tooltip: Language used for BOCCHI’s windows and messages.

open_on_occult_crescent_entry.label: Open BOCCHI on Occult Crescent entry
open_on_occult_crescent_entry.tooltip: Automatically open the BOCCHI main window when entering South or North Horn.

show_experience_tracker.label: Show experience tracker
show_experience_tracker.tooltip: Show the experience panel in the main window.

show_experience_tracker_graph.label: Show experience graph
show_experience_tracker_graph.tooltip: Show the experience graph under the tracker.

show_currency_tracker.label: Show currency tracker
show_currency_tracker.tooltip: Show the currency panel in the main window.

show_currency_tracker_graph.label: Show currency graph
show_currency_tracker_graph.tooltip: Show the currency graph under the tracker.

show_world_section.label: Show FATEs & CEs list
show_world_section.tooltip: Show active FATEs and Critical Encounters in the main window.

show_demiatma_drops.label: Show demiatma drops (South Horn)
show_demiatma_drops.tooltip: South Horn only. Show demiatma icons on FATEs and CEs. Green border = you still need it; red = you already have 3.

show_note_drops.label: Show field note drops
show_note_drops.tooltip: Show field note icons on FATEs and CEs that drop them (South Horn and North Horn).

show_soul_shard_drops.label: Show soul shard drops (South Horn)
show_soul_shard_drops.tooltip: South Horn only. Show phantom job soul shard icons on CEs that drop them.

show_buff_section.label: Show Apply Buffs button
show_buff_section.tooltip: Show the Apply Buffs / Stop Buffs control under the status chips in the main window.

show_automation_section.label: Show Illegal Mode section
show_automation_section.tooltip: Show Illegal Mode controls in the main window.

show_completionist_section.label: Show Completionist section
show_completionist_section.tooltip: Show Completionist Mode (start/stop, field-note checklist) in the main window.

show_mob_farmer_section.label: Show Mob Farmer section
show_mob_farmer_section.tooltip: Show Mob Farmer controls in the main window.

show_pots_treasure_section.label: Show Pots & Treasure section
show_pots_treasure_section.tooltip: Show Pots & Treasure controls in the main window.

show_treasure_section.label: Show Treasure Hunter section
show_treasure_section.tooltip: Show Treasure Hunter and Carrot Hunt status and controls in the main window.

show_bocchi_chat_prefix.label: Show BOCCHI chat messages
show_bocchi_chat_prefix.tooltip: Print plugin messages to chat with a [BOCCHI] tag. Turn off to hide them (startup MOTD still shows).
